title: Happy End
events_chronological: Bedrich, a butcher, marries Julie and the two set up house above the shop.
Julie takes a lover called Ptacek, and Bedrich works out what is going on.
Bedrich kills Julie and dismembers her on the block in his own shop.
Bedrich distributes the parts around the city in parcels and a suitcase.
Bedrich takes up with a young woman named Vera who knows nothing about any of it.
Bedrich kills Ptacek and disposes of him in the same way.
The parcels are found and the police open a murder investigation.
Bedrich is arrested in his flat and taken away in front of the neighbours.
Bedrich stands trial while the court hears what was in the parcels.
Bedrich is beheaded in the prison yard.
Bedrich's body is buried and his effects are returned to nobody in particular.
syuzhet_notes: Every shot is printed and played in reverse, and a narrator reads the result as though it were the right way round, so the film opens on the execution and calls it a birth. Told-order bullet 1 is the last thing in the story and bullet 12 the first.
fabula_notes: The bullets record the events in the order a clock would put them, not in the order the reversed narration claims for them.
